・落ちこぼれの猟犬: 褒められたい一心でがんばる、時には牙をむいちゃうメイドさん

・操り人形: 自身を人よりお人形さんと考えてしまう

Hello! I love your style and would love to commission artwork of my elf character named Key, who is a necromancer!

Key is about 149 cm tall, a pear-type body — her upper half, such as her arms & chest, are narrower/smaller, and she carries most of her weight in her thighs. She has short, fluffy hair that curls into her face to frame her cheekbones and ends around the nape of her neck. Her eyes are downturned with heavy lower eyelashes (she looks very mischievous, smug.) She has freckles dusted across her cheeks, down her shoulders and arms, and on her butt. 

Key’s personality is cheeky, playfully mischievous. She is a necromancer (magic user who controls the dead) with a creepy-cute feeling. I’d like to see her drawn with a smug facial expression, a hand up to her face as if she’s giggling, surrounded by dark magic items (bones/skulls, neon green/teal magic, magic books, melted candles and potions.

References are included in a Pinterest board, linked in the ref URL.

https://pin.it/4aV0EPMOF
